en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front displays a black-and-white photograph of a rural landscape with forested hills, scattered houses, and a prominently placed church with a tall white steeple. Handwritten text at the bottom reads 'Sköns kyrka' and a greeting. The reverse side is formatted as a traditional postcard with green ornamental border and printed text in Swedish and French ('BREFKORT / CARTE POSTALE'). Handwritten information addresses the card to a church warden and includes a location in Föllinge, Jämtland county. The postmark stamp is partly visible.
